2_budget_non_monotonicity.covered_by: NOTHING — this is a separate, UNEXPLAINED fact about the object being admitted, and marked-unvalidated does not address it
2_budget_non_monotonicity.sharpened: The arm BEATS MATCHED RANDOM at ALL THREE budgets while beating the INCUMBENT at only two. That gap is the concrete form of 'beating random is not beating the incumbent' for this candidate.
2_budget_non_monotonicity.statement: The increment over the incumbent survives joint reading at ['5%', '10%'] and is INDISTINGUISHABLE FROM CHANCE at ['15%'] (Holm 1.0000, raw p 0.6677). No mechanism has been offered for why a larger cancellation budget should erase the advantage. An effect present at two budgets and absent at the third is not established.

admission_statement: Admitted WITHOUT clearing validation. Development evidence only: btc @5% and @10% increments over the incumbent, under an OPTIMISTIC window-level null. This is not a validated candidate and the freeze does not assert that it is.
authority: USER RULING relayed as R-232: LGBM_PINNED enters the forward race btc-only, marked-unvalidated.

candidate.model_class: LGBM classifier + LGBM value regressor, params pinned in phase2_declaration (LGBM_PARAMS / LGBM_VALUE_PARAMS)
candidate.thresholds: CAUSAL_FROZEN_FROM_TRAIN, per budget, frozen before scoring

cluster_unit_disclosure.why: G is 0 complete UTC days, so the ruled unit has no replicates. The window is the finest plausibly-exchangeable unit available; windows within a day are NOT independent, so these p-values are OPTIMISTIC and are evidence, not a significance certificate.

increment_over_incumbent.design: window-level sign-flip permutation of per-window paired increment sums vs INCUMBENT_REWEIGHTED_ONLY on the identical action population
increment_over_incumbent.multiplicity: Holm-Bonferroni across all 12 cells, read JOINTLY

matched_random.design: randoms cancel the same number of generations, matched within (side x hour) strata, each at its FIRST row
